scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix vite-project"
scripts.postbuild: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(fs.existsSync('vite-project/dist')) { fs.cpSync('vite-project/dist', 'dist', {recursive: true}); console.log('Copied vite-project/dist to root dist'); }"
